notes.title: Update Log #10 – Demo Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468257/2a75322dcee1ca9211fa03f8e1e85d5b4b871cbc.png

The demo has been updated!

+ You can now play up to Main Quest 3 in the demo.
+ All 108 playable characters are now available in the demo.
+ You can now upgrade your party’s stats using tickets.
+ The tutorial has been expanded with more explanations.

– Classic Mode has been removed.
– Chaos Mode has been removed.

Note: If you have existing save data from a previous demo version, the game may not function properly. It is recommended to reset your save data via the in-game cheat menu.

[previewyoutube=ZpK4vgnK5Ys;full][/previewyoutube]
What’s next?

I’m now preparing free post-launch content updates!

1. New Main Quests
2. New Questers
3. New Skills
4. New Classes

Hello!
I've decided to post a Pre-Demo Update Log here to share the current development progress of the demo build before its release. After the demo release and the full game launch, I plan to continue posting update logs in this format.

2025.03.08
Update Log
